source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for the feedback!
Our current website for the Bay Area locations, San Francisco CA and Fairfield CA, is [URL_001].
For bookings, WE USE WIX.
We are opening an additional location in Seattle WA, and it will open under the name Smash Room because our brand will be Smash Room from now on. We therefore want [URL_002] to serve as our master site, bringing our brand, locations, and information together in one place. It should include sublinks for each location while enabling every location to track its own bookings, revenue, and sales separately.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The main site wouldn’t require a booking system because its sibling sites would handle the bookings.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle must use a standalone Wix account and remain entirely separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle must have separate:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

Customers should experience it as the same SMASH ROOM brand, while all backend operations remain completely independent.

Initially, Seattle should be presented as a “Coming Soon” location.

The Seattle page must follow this layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

The buttons should be:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Design the page so that when Seattle opens, booking only needs to be enabled and the photos updated, with no page redesign required.

Use the Seattle page as the template for future locations.

value_updates.seattle_booking_public_status: disabled while Seattle is coming soon
value_updates.seattle_booking_activation_condition: enable booking when Seattle opens without requiring a page redesign

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hello, the website has neither packages nor any booking software.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the website has no booking software.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Because you said the second one is coming soon, I have just installed the booking system on it.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports installing the booking system on the second, coming-soon website.

routing_warnings.description: The unlinked location button concerns routing between the master and location sites rather than booking functionality.
This repeats that the location button remains unlinked and belongs to location routing.
The separate clause reporting that packages are absent is failure evidence for the location package catalog.
The Seattle and master sites being assigned to the wrong profiles concerns site and profile mapping.
The inability to switch the site or domain concerns correcting domain and Wix profile mapping.
